long_description: Lightfully Behavioral Health is a primary mental health care provider established in 2021, offering treatment across the care continuum from residential to virtual intensive outpatient programs. The organization uses a proprietary Precision Care Model that combines evidence-based therapies to create personalized treatment plans based on patient goals. Lightfully emphasizes rigorous outcomes measurement, conducting weekly assessments to track patient progress and demonstrate effectiveness. Their 2024-2025 clinical outcomes data shows significant results: 88% of adult clients with depression reported improvement at discharge, 86% with psychological distress showed improvement, 41% reduction in depression scores, 45% reduction in anxiety scores, and 32% reduction in PTSD scores. The organization serves patients from adolescence through late adulthood (ages 12-79) with dedicated programs for teens and adults. Lightfully has also implemented AI-powered chart auditing (via Brellium) to reduce chart review time by 87%.

faqs.q: What treatment levels does Lightfully offer?
faqs.a: Lightfully offers residential treatment, partial hospitalization (PHP), intensive outpatient (IOP), and virtual IOP programs for mental health conditions.
Lightfully reports 88% of depression patients show improvement at discharge, with 41% reduction in depression scores, 45% reduction in anxiety scores, and 32% reduction in PTSD scores.

faqs.q: What is Lightfully's Precision Care Model?
faqs.a: The Precision Care Model is Lightfully's proprietary approach combining evidence-based therapies to create personalized treatment plans based on patient goals rather than just symptoms.
Lightfully conducts weekly assessments with patients to track progress throughout treatment, measuring improvement in depression, anxiety, PTSD, and psychological distress.
